exitDecision.clusterCollapseExpandDeferred: Existing semantic community overview and filtered subgraph already provide bounded cluster entry and return; proxy-node collapse would add layout and persistence risk without demonstrated incremental value.
exitDecision.graphFullscreenDeferred: Three required desktop viewports already preserve controls, canvas, details and minimap; fullscreen is not required for the professional visual acceptance goals.
exitDecision.governanceRingsDeferred: No canonical per-node governance status contract exists.
